definitions.gloss: to move around, to move about
definitions.explanation: To change position or location repeatedly, moving in various directions.

definitions.gloss: to be active, to be on the move
definitions.explanation: To be physically active, not staying still.

examples.english: The dog is moving around the yard.

notes:
{動|うご}き{回|まわ}る is an intransitive verb (⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧) meaning to move around.

ETYMOLOGY:
- ⟦{動|うご}く→動く：00904_ugoku⟧ (to move) + ⟦{回|まわ}る→回る：01150_mawaru⟧ (to go around) → to move around

ASPECT (ている):
{動|うご}き{回|まわ}って⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ indicates an ongoing state of moving around, often restlessly.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{落|お}ち{着|つ}かず→落ち着く：04670_ochitsuku⟧{動|うご}き{回|まわ}る (move around restlessly)
- ⟦あちこち→あちこち：01687_achikochi⟧{動|うご}き{回|まわ}る (move around everywhere)
- ⟦{自由|じゆう}→自由：01148_jiyuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{動|うご}き{回|まわ}る (move around freely)

USAGE:
More general than ⟦{歩|ある}き{回|まわ}る→歩き回る：04605_arukimawaru⟧ (walking) or ⟦{走|はし}り{回|まわ}る→走り回る：04608_hashirimawaru⟧ (running). Can be used for any kind of movement including crawling, shuffling, etc.
